reason: The commission pain is real, I paid Booking.com on a no-show last week. But a studio in another city building a guest app and a WhatsApp assistant for my island is a lot to hand over, and I would not pay $800 or more for something I have not seen work for a guesthouse like mine.
objection: A remote studio does not know my island or my guests, and my guests message me on WhatsApp, not in an app.
would_change_my_mind: A free trial month where a few of my own Booking.com guests book the direct page and the boat transfer and deposit work with M-Pesa, with no fee until the guests arrive.
